## About these sources

The pooled slice covers 2018 Zilla Parishad seats. Separately,
[named Birbhum Pradhan reservation observations](derived/birbhum_reservations/README.md)
cover the 1998 and 2003 terms, with raw codes, year exceptions and source
conflicts preserved. The [reservation gap matrix](vintage_search/README.md)
tracks historical district/cycle coverage. Results without reservation
fields are tabled and do not fill any reservation gap.

A September 2026
source search recovered raw GP reservation documents for Birbhum, Jalpaiguri,
Cooch Behar and Alipurduar for 2023, and historical district sources for
2003, 2008, 2013 and 2018. Alipurduar's 2018 results archive includes GP
candidate votes, winners and constituency reservation status.

[Derived tables](derived/README.md) include named Nadia 2013 Pradhan/deputy
reservations, historical and 2023 office schedules, ward reservations,
Alipurduar results and separate verification aggregates. The
[full page ledger](derived/parsing_inventory/pages.csv) records extraction,
parser coverage and remaining review. Office mentions, member seats and
candidate rows are distinct units; a parsed count does not certify an OCR name.

[The GP source search](gp_source_search.md) links the raw files, source
manifests and manual-entry index. Drafts, final orders, results and aggregate
tables are distinguished there. These acquisitions are not yet included in
the pooled reservation dataset.

## Provenance

Every row carries `source_path` and `source_page` — the document it was read from and the page within it. The documents are committed here, so any row can be checked against the page it came from without a network round trip. That mattered repeatedly: nearly every parser bug in this repository produced plausible wrong values rather than an error, and opening the page was the only way to settle it.

All 20 cited documents are present.

Inventory for this directory: 1063 other, 285 scan, 279 digital-text, 32 tabular, 6 archive, 4 mixed, 4,149 pages total.

## Reproducing

```
make wb
```

Parses from the committed documents and rewrites the files above, then runs `src/local_reservations/states/wb/validate.py`.

## What is checked

Every state runs a shared battery first — the seat key is unique, the reservation label agrees with the two fields it summarises, every `source_path` exists and every `source_page` falls inside its document. Then this state's own checks, which are the ones that catch silent corruption because they appeal to something outside the data:

- the reviewed total of 825 zilla-parishad seats
- all 20 district gazettes represented
- complete, unique district seat runs from 1 through N


| Check | Appeals to | 2018 `zp_member` |
|---|---|---|
| `alias_family_exclusive` | internal | &check; 0 |
| `blank_share_within_tolerance` | declared | &check; |
| `caste_scheme_respected` | declared | &check; BC,NONE,SC,ST |
| `caste_share_vs_population` | external | &ndash; 0 |
| `coverage_vs_published` | external | &ndash; 825 |
| `label_agrees` | internal | &check; 0 |
| `plausible_vs_registry` | external | &ndash; |
| `provenance_resolves` | internal | &check; 0 |
| `reservation_constant_within_seat` | internal | &ndash; |
| `rows_in_band` | declared | &ndash; 825 |
| `seat_key_unique` | internal | &check; 0 |
| `tier_local_maps_to_one_tier` | internal | &check; zilla parishad member |
| `winner_caste_is_not_the_seats` | internal | &ndash; 0 |
| `women_share_by_block` | external | &ndash; |
| `women_share_vs_statute` | external | &check; 49.5% |
| `year_constant` | internal | &check; 2018 |

&check; pass &nbsp; ! warn &nbsp; &cross; fail &nbsp; &ndash; skipped, meaning no rule is declared for that slice — which is not the same as passing.

Each check declares what it **appeals to**. Only an external appeal - a published total, a statutory share, a population - reliably catches silent corruption; an internal check confirms the file agrees with itself, which it does whether or not a category was misread.

Column meanings are in [../../DICTIONARY.md](../../DICTIONARY.md). Expectation violations across every state are triaged into [../expectations_report.csv](../expectations_report.csv).
